name: 3D Comic Creator Tool Game
summary:
Unleash your creativity with 3D Comic Creator Tool Game, a tool born from the European ArtisticMinds project, empowering everyone to design, build, and share their own 3D comic worlds.

Craft stunning stories using customizable characters, dynamic environments, and intuitive scene-building tools. Whether you are a beginner, an educator, or an emerging digital artist, the app offers an accessible, playful, and culturally inspired space to explore visual storytelling.
